platform: CKUW 95.9 FM Digital Download-Link and Physical Media Submission Route
manual_review_reason: CKUW rejects unsolicited MP3 attachments. A human must select an appropriate MarcsMusic release, prepare a stable high-quality downloadable link suitable for broadcast, verify current metadata and international-eligibility requirements, use the official Music Director route manually, and handle any cassette, CD, vinyl or reel-to-reel package. Do not use general office, request, interview or feedback routes as substitutes. Stop if any CAPTCHA, login, mandatory payment or new restriction appears.

platform: 101.5 UMFM / CJUM Digital Download-Link and CD Submission Route
manual_review_reason: UMFM accepts secure downloadable links through its official Program Director email action and rejects individual audio-file attachments. A human must confirm whether digital singles and international submissions are eligible, select an appropriate release, use WeTransfer, Dropbox, Google Drive, Bandcamp, DISCO or another approved secure link, and send through the protected first-party action without decoding or guessing the address. Physical singles are rejected and EPs require at least four songs. Stop if any CAPTCHA, login, mandatory payment or new restriction appears.
